_comment: Which requests are handed to the Pages Functions worker.
This used to be include:['/*'] with a list of asset exclusions, meaning every
HTML page view woke the worker, found no handler, and fell through to the
static asset. There is no _middleware in functions/, so that work was pure
overhead — and on the free plan it spends the 100k/day invocation budget on
page views instead of actual API calls.
Every Function in this project lives under /api/, so that is the only prefix
that needs routing. Everything else is served straight from the CDN edge,
If a _middleware.js is ever added, widen this back to '/*' or middleware will
silently stop running on page routes.
